answer: We formulate consensus security within a decentralized state garden, binding identity creation to dynamic opportunity-cost collateral verified by zero-knowledge delay proofs. Mapping multi-agent actions onto a subgame-perfect punishment matrix guarantees that an adversary spawning a cedar tree of Sybil identities triggers slashing penalties that sink capital into a liquidity lagoon. Because identity multiplication yields a strictly negative expected utility, honest single-identity staking converges to a strict Nash equilibrium.
